name: Rakho
why: A new American house pitching accessible upscale: shirts, sportswear and soft tailoring cut in Italian-inspired cloth and sold wholesale.
origin: A division of Thames Apparel, which John and Christina Yuan founded in 1998; Rakho itself launched in late 2025.
opview: The house describes itself as a modern reading of American elegance, built for a man moving between settings in one day.

onething.n: the detail the trade press singled out at launch — $158 in cotton, $198 in a cashmere blend. Collection page; no stable single-SKU URL established

notes.craft: made in a China factory that also produces for established designer labels — the pitch is that make, at a lower price
notes.reach: about nine months old at the time of seating; the register is asserted rather than demonstrated
notes.cashmere: cashmere blends appear at the top of the shirt range and in outerwear rather than in knitwear

cities: No US own retail established; wholesale-first, shown at market and carried by specialty independents
